name: n05-practice-wrong-spec
description: Negative control: deliberately wrong expectations, as an incorrectly inferred specification would produce. The evaluator must report fail/error for these and pass only for the control case.
spec_source: deliberately wrong; see practice/n05/README.md for the real behaviour
